tags.name: Old Puttalam Road
tags.note: Road declared under Gazette of 06-06-1989 as the B234 Rd. Startin at the Pandulagama Clock Tower; ending at A’pura Helipad Entrance Jct. No person has the authority to alter the trace unless such changes are redefined and published through a new Gazette.

tags.name: Sri Saranankara Sangarakkitha Mawatha (Vessagiriya Road)
tags.note: This road segment is a Part of (B397-8-Jayanthi RB-Isurumuniya Road) and as per name board displayed road name is Vessagiriya Road.

tags.name: Outer Circular Road (Watawandana Road)
